description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for the ScreenDao data access object within the OrangeHRM project. It tests the retrieval of screen entities from the database using predefined test data, verifying the correctness of the getScreen method.

classes.name: ScreenDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing the ScreenDao's data retrieval functionality.
